**Seattle Parks and Recreation, Ballard Pool**
- 
Its lessons include parent & child lessons (6 months to 4 years of age) and preschool lessons.

- The page doesn't give an age range for the preschool class, so I left the age fit blank. It also posts no winter day, time or price that I could read.
- Parks pools run on a quarterly schedule. 
Registration opens at 12:00 noon
 on the posted date, and 
families on scholarships may register 1 week early.

- I couldn't find the winter registration date. The only date I saw was for fall, which was Aug 11.
- Queen Anne Pool isn't offering lessons during its maintenance closure. 
Extra lesson capacity has been added at Ballard Pool and Evans Pool.


**YMCA of Greater Seattle**
- 
Stage One (Water Acclimation) is listed for preschool ages 3-5.

- 
Group lessons are 30 minutes long and sold in sessions of six or eight classes, and registration opens seasonally.

- 
Lessons are open to both members and non-members.

- I couldn't tie a winter branch, schedule or price to this class. The YMCA's own Swim Basics Preschool page showed 
"this class isn't currently offered"
 without a branch selected, so check availability at your nearest branch.
